quarters.supplementaryReportName: Q4 2025 Supplemental Financial Information (prior-period comparative columns)

notes.roe: Reported ROE was negative (-1.0%) this quarter due to a reported net loss of $181 million, driven primarily by a US$2.6 billion provision related to the U.S. BSA/AML investigations. Adjusted ROE (non-GAAP) was 14.1% for comparison. Net income figure shown is the reported consolidated net income (loss); net income attributable to common shareholders (reported) was -$250 million.
notes.efficiencyRatio: Reported efficiency ratio of 77.7% was elevated due to the AML-related charge; adjusted efficiency ratio net of ISE was 57.3%.
notes.cet1Ratio: Figures for this quarter were sourced from the comparative-period columns in TD's Q4 2025 Supplemental Financial Information package (which restates/repeats prior quarters), cross-checked against the Q3 2024 earnings release commentary.
notes.loansToAssetsPct: Computed as loans net of allowance for loan losses ($938,325mm) divided by total assets ($1,967,181mm) per the Q2 2026 SFI balance sheet table (which carries 8 quarters of comparatives).
notes.loanToDepositRatio: Computed as gross loans ($946,136mm) / total deposits ($1,220,550mm) from the consolidated Balance Sheet table in TD's Q2 2026 Supplemental Financial Information (which carries 9 quarters of comparatives back to Q2 2024).
notes.wholesaleDepositsPct: Banks ($36,239mm) + Business and government ($553,662mm) = $589,901mm / total deposits ($1,220,550mm).
notes.newMetricsSource: Q2 2026 Supplemental Financial Information (Balance Sheet table, prior-period comparative column) — https://www.td.com/content/dam/tdcom/canada/about-td/pdf/quarterly-results/2026/q2/2026-q2-financial-supppack-en.pdf
notes.irrbbEveSensitivityPct: TD Table 31 "Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity Measures" (Q3 2024 Report to Shareholders, disclosed quarterly). TD discloses only a +/-100bp parallel shock, not the six-scenario Basel/OSFI IRRBB template. Most adverse: +100bp parallel increase, before-tax EVE impact -$2,485mm (total) ÷ Net Tier 1 Capital $88,898mm (Basel III CC1 capital table, same report) = -2.8%. This %-of-Tier-1 framing is computed here, not disclosed by TD.
notes.irrbbNiiSensitivityPct: Same Table 31: +100bp parallel increase → 12-month NII impact +$785mm (total) ÷ Net Tier 1 Capital $88,898mm = 0.88%. Recorded at the +100bp shock (same direction as the EVE figure) for consistency with TD's own Q4 disclosure; a derived ratio, not published by TD.
notes.stableDepositsPct: Stable deposits $262,642M as a share of total retail and small-business deposits $484,934M ($262,642M stable + $222,292M less stable). Denominator is the retail and small-business book, so this bucket and less stable deposits sum to 100%.
notes.lessStableDepositsPct: Less stable deposits $222,292M as a share of total retail and small-business deposits $484,934M ($262,642M stable + $222,292M less stable). Denominator is the retail and small-business book, so this bucket and stable deposits sum to 100%.
notes.operationalDepositsPct: Operational deposits $128,024M as a share of total wholesale deposits $333,081M ($128,024M operational + $205,057M non-operational). Denominator is the wholesale book, so this bucket and non-operational deposits sum to 100%.
notes.nonOperationalDepositsPct: Non-operational deposits $205,057M as a share of total wholesale deposits $333,081M ($128,024M operational + $205,057M non-operational). Denominator is the wholesale book, so this bucket and operational deposits sum to 100%.
notes.tlacLeverageRatio: TLAC as a percentage of leverage ratio exposure, per OSFI's TLAC guideline. Cross-checked against an overlapping supplementary/Pillar 3 disclosure.
notes.dividendPayoutRatio: Reported basis (TD also publishes an adjusted payout ratio). Q3 2024 is disclosed as n/m because the AML provision produced a net loss; Q2 2025 is depressed by the Schwab disposition gain.
notes.roa: COMPUTED on an ADJUSTED basis -- TD does not disclose an ROA. Adjusted net income after tax $3,646M (TD's own adjusted figure, not reported), annualised over 92 days in the quarter (x365/92), divided by the bank's own disclosed average total assets $1,968,000M = 0.74%. Average assets are cited; the ratio is derived. Switched from reported to adjusted net income for consistency with ROTCE, operating leverage and diluted EPS, which are adjusted throughout this dataset.
notes.adjustedOperatingLeverage: TD does not publish a numeric quarterly operating leverage. It is stated only qualitatively ('fourth consecutive quarter of positive operating leverage, on an adjusted basis') and as a forward target, in the earnings release, the report to shareholders, the financial supplement and the Q2 2026 investor presentation. TD's own glossary defines the measure as adjusted revenue growth less adjusted expense growth, but never tabulates it.
notes.rotce: Disclosed, ADJUSTED basis: 18.8% adjusted return on tangible common equity for Q3 2024, read from page 4 of the cited document. Taken from the issuer's "adjusted" ROTCE row, which sits directly beside its reported one. Adjusted measures remove each bank's own items of note, so the adjustments differ between issuers.
notes.equityMultiplier: Computed from two disclosed figures: average total assets $1,968,000M divided by average common equity $100,677M = 19.55x. Both operands are published in the issuer's own financial supplementary information. Average COMMON equity is the denominator so the DuPont identity holds against the ROE and ROA already in this dataset (ROA x multiplier is approximately ROE).
notes.adjustedDilutedEps: Disclosed: $2.05 adjusted diluted earnings per share for Q3 2024. TD states this in the earnings-release highlights rather than a table ("adjusted diluted earnings per share were $X, compared with $Y"). Each quarter's year-ago comparison reproduces the figure recorded four quarters earlier, at all four joins. Adjusted measures remove each issuer's own items of note, so the adjustments differ between banks even though every figure here is the bank's own published number.
notes.lcrBufferBillions: COMPUTED: high-quality liquid assets less total net cash outflows -- the cushion above the 100% LCR requirement. HQLA $337,631.0M less net cash outflows $262,308.0M = $75.3B. Both operands are disclosed in the issuer's LCR common disclosure template (page 121), and the pair reproduces the LCR percentage printed on that same page.

irrbbDisclosureNote: TD discloses IRRBB every quarter in its Report to Shareholders MD&A under the 'Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity Measures' table (Table 31 in the interim reports; Table 45 in the year-end Annual Report). It does not use the standardized six-scenario Basel/OSFI IRRBB1 template (parallel up, parallel down, steepener, flattener, short rate up, short rate down) — that template could not be found in TD's quarterly Reports to Shareholders, the FY2024/FY2025 Annual Reports, or the Q4 2025 Pillar 3 Supplemental Regulatory Disclosure, despite TD being a G-SIB/D-SIB subject to OSFI's Pillar 3 guideline. Instead, TD shows both Economic Value of Shareholders' Equity (EVE) Sensitivity and Net Interest Income (NII) Sensitivity for a single prescribed shock: an immediate and sustained +/-100 basis point parallel shift, before-tax. Effective July 31, 2025, TD began splitting the two sensitivity measures by currency (Canadian dollar vs. U.S. dollar) in addition to the total. Both measures explicitly exclude exposures from the Wholesale Banking segment. TD does not itself express either sensitivity as a percentage of any capital base — the %-of-Tier-1 figures in this dataset were computed by dividing TD's disclosed dollar sensitivity by TD's Net Tier 1 Capital from the same quarter's Basel III Capital Position (CC1) table.
